$comment: Compressed npm download size must be strictly below 10 MB decimal (10,000,000 bytes). The historical baseline is informational for packed size. The editor data (@aceshooting/lyra-ide) and the locale catalogs (@aceshooting/lyra-translations) ship in companion packages, so the unpacked ceiling now enforces the 25% reduction from that baseline without an exception; file-count derivation reserves seven artifacts beyond the measured 308-alias inventory. Each companion has its own hard ceilings under `companions`. Required public artifacts and artifact hygiene are validated independently of every size ceiling.
